_readme: Edit this file, then run `python scripts/build.py`. It regenerates publications.html, and fills the marked blocks in index.html and research.html: `selected: true` -> Selected publications on the home page; `tags` such as home1/home2/home3 -> example papers under the three research areas on the home page; strand1..strand5 -> key papers under each strand on the research page. `type` is article, chapter or working. `url` is a DOI, arXiv or other link.
